disclaimer: Results are WCAG readiness observations and cannot establish conformance. A knowledgeable human must evaluate complete pages, complete processes, accessibility-supported use, and all applicable Level A and AA success criteria.

standard.name: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
standard.targetConformance: Level AA (all Level A and Level AA success criteria)

sources.name: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.role: Normative specification and success-criterion anchors for readiness mapping.

sources.name: W3C WAI test and evaluate guidance
sources.role: Evaluation-process context; human judgment remains required.

sources.name: W3C WAI selecting evaluation tools guidance
sources.role: Tool-selection context for automated readiness observations.

runtimePolicy.network: Tests run against an authorized local target and locally installed tools only.
runtimePolicy.disclaimer: Automated checks provide readiness evidence and cannot establish WCAG conformance. A knowledgeable human must evaluate the complete page, complete processes, accessibility-supported use, and every applicable Level A and AA success criterion.

suites.title: WCAG 2.2 Level A/AA locally automatable readiness checks
suites.purpose: Collect deterministic or repeatable machine evidence and identify likely failures for human review.

tests.title: Non-text Content
tests.applicability: Pages containing images, controls, CAPTCHA, charts, or other non-text content.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright with a local DOM/accessibility rule runner
tests.limitations: Automation can detect absent or suspicious alternatives but cannot determine whether an alternative serves the same purpose.

tests.title: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
tests.applicability: Prerecorded audio-only or video-only media.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright plus local ffprobe metadata inspection
tests.limitations: Presence checks cannot establish that the alternative presents equivalent information.

tests.title: Captions (Prerecorded)
tests.applicability: Prerecorded synchronized media containing audio.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright plus local WebVTT/TTML parser
tests.limitations: Automation cannot reliably judge caption accuracy, speaker identification, or meaningful sound descriptions.

tests.title: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
tests.applicability: Prerecorded video in synchronized media.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright plus local ffprobe metadata inspection
tests.limitations: Track presence does not establish that important visual information is adequately described.

tests.title: Info and Relationships
tests.applicability: Markup-based content with headings, lists, tables, forms, regions, or visual grouping.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright with a local semantic-structure rule runner
tests.limitations: Automation cannot fully infer all visually conveyed relationships or determine whether markup represents the intended meaning.

tests.title: Meaningful Sequence
tests.applicability: Content whose meaning can depend on reading or navigation order.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright order analyzer
tests.limitations: A human must determine whether a particular sequence affects meaning.

tests.title: Orientation
tests.applicability: Responsive web content used in portrait and landscape orientations.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright viewport and orientation runner
tests.limitations: Automation may miss essential orientation requirements and interaction problems that require human use.

tests.title: Identify Input Purpose
tests.applicability: Fields collecting information about the user where an identified input purpose applies.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright form-purpose rule runner
tests.limitations: A human must confirm that each field's actual purpose matches the programmatic token.

tests.title: Audio Control
tests.applicability: Pages where audio starts automatically and continues for more than three seconds.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright media-state runner
tests.limitations: Browser autoplay policy can hide application behavior; a human must verify controls are usable and independent of system volume.

tests.title: Contrast (Minimum)
tests.applicability: Rendered text and images of text, subject to the criterion's exceptions.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright with a local contrast analyzer
tests.limitations: Complex backgrounds, anti-aliasing, images of text, logos, disabled controls, and exception judgments require review.

tests.title: Resize Text
tests.applicability: Text other than captions and images of text.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright text-resize runner with screenshot comparison
tests.limitations: Machine checks can detect likely clipping but cannot guarantee all content and functionality remain usable.

tests.title: Reflow
tests.applicability: Web content viewed at the equivalent of 320 CSS pixels wide or 256 CSS pixels high, subject to exceptions.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright reflow and overflow runner
tests.limitations: A human must assess two-dimensional-layout exceptions and whether content or functionality is actually lost.

tests.title: Text Spacing
tests.applicability: Text in markup languages supporting the specified spacing properties.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright text-spacing override runner
tests.limitations: A human must verify that no content or functionality is lost, especially in complex or stateful components.

tests.title: Content on Hover or Focus
tests.applicability: Additional content that appears on pointer hover or keyboard focus.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright hover-and-focus behavior runner
tests.limitations: Automation may not discover every trigger or reliably judge exceptions and user experience.

tests.title: No Keyboard Trap
tests.applicability: Pages with focusable or custom interactive components.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright keyboard traversal runner
tests.limitations: Finite automation cannot prove the absence of traps in every state or confirm that nonstandard exit instructions are understandable.

tests.title: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
tests.applicability: Pages containing animation, video, canvas, or rapidly changing content.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local frame capture and general/red-flash threshold analyzer
tests.limitations: Coverage depends on reaching every animated state and faithfully capturing rendered frames.

tests.title: Bypass Blocks
tests.applicability: Pages with blocks of content repeated across pages.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright landmark and skip-link runner
tests.limitations: Automation cannot always identify which blocks repeat or whether a provided mechanism is effective for users.

tests.title: Page Titled
tests.applicability: Every web page in the assessment scope.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright title inventory runner
tests.limitations: A human must judge whether each title describes the page's topic or purpose.

tests.title: Link Purpose (In Context)
tests.applicability: Pages containing links.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright link-purpose heuristic runner
tests.limitations: Human judgment is required to determine purpose from context and whether the ambiguity exception applies.

tests.title: Headings and Labels
tests.applicability: Pages containing headings or labels.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright heading-and-label inventory runner
tests.limitations: A human must decide whether headings and labels actually describe topic or purpose.

tests.title: Focus Visible
tests.applicability: Keyboard-operable user interfaces.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright focus-style differential runner
tests.limitations: Image comparison cannot always determine whether an indicator is perceptible or whether every operating mode was covered.

tests.title: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
tests.applicability: Pages with keyboard-focusable components and author-created sticky, modal, or overlay content.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright focus occlusion runner
tests.limitations: Automation may miss configurable interface states, user-movable content, or focus paths requiring domain knowledge.

tests.title: Label in Name
tests.applicability: User interface components with visible text labels.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright visible-label/accessibility-name comparator
tests.limitations: Text extraction and reading-order heuristics can be ambiguous; symbol labels and language-specific cases require review.

tests.title: Target Size (Minimum)
tests.applicability: Pointer input targets, subject to the criterion's exceptions.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright target-size geometry runner
tests.limitations: A human must evaluate exceptions for equivalent controls, inline targets, user-agent control, and essential presentation.

tests.title: Language of Page
tests.applicability: Every web page in the assessment scope.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local HTML language-attribute validator
tests.limitations: Automated language detection is probabilistic and a human may need to verify that the declared language matches the content.

tests.title: On Focus
tests.applicability: Pages with focusable user interface components.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright focus side-effect runner
tests.limitations: Automation may not recognize every form of context change or reach every conditional component.

tests.title: On Input
tests.applicability: User interface controls whose settings can be changed.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright input side-effect runner
tests.limitations: A human must determine whether advance advice is sufficient and whether all conditional states were exercised.

tests.title: Consistent Navigation
tests.applicability: Sets of pages with repeated navigation mechanisms.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local crawler plus Playwright navigation-structure comparator
tests.limitations: A human must define the set of pages and distinguish user-initiated changes or legitimate page variations.

tests.title: Consistent Help
tests.applicability: Sets of pages that contain repeated human contact, self-help, or automated contact mechanisms.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local crawler plus Playwright help-order comparator
tests.limitations: A human must confirm which elements qualify as help mechanisms and which pages belong to the same set and variation.

tests.title: Labels or Instructions
tests.applicability: Content requiring user input.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright form-label and instruction inventory runner
tests.limitations: Automation cannot reliably judge whether instructions are sufficient for the expected input.

tests.title: Redundant Entry
tests.applicability: Multi-step processes that ask users to enter information previously supplied in the same process.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright stateful form-journey runner
tests.limitations: A human must judge security, necessity, invalidity, and re-entry exceptions and ensure representative processes were tested.

tests.title: Name, Role, Value
tests.applicability: All user interface components, especially custom scripted controls.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright accessibility-tree and ARIA rule runner
tests.limitations: Automation cannot establish support across every assistive-technology and user-agent combination or judge whether exposed semantics are correct in context.

tests.title: Status Messages
tests.applicability: Markup-based applications that present status messages without moving focus.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright live-region and status-message runner
tests.limitations: A human must confirm that all relevant messages are exposed and that assistive technologies present them appropriately.

suites.title: WCAG 2.2 Level A/AA manual-required checks
suites.purpose: Guide knowledgeable human evaluation where intent, meaning, completeness, exceptions, or full user interaction cannot be established by automation.

tests.title: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
tests.applicability: Prerecorded video in synchronized media.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local media player and structured reviewer checklist
tests.limitations: Requires human comparison of visual information with the audio description or full text alternative.

tests.title: Captions (Live)
tests.applicability: Live synchronized media containing audio.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local capture/player and caption-review worksheet
tests.limitations: A live human-observed session is needed to judge accuracy, timing, speaker identification, and meaningful sounds.

tests.title: Sensory Characteristics
tests.applicability: Instructions provided for understanding or operating content.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Browser plus structured content-review checklist
tests.limitations: Human judgment is needed to determine whether instructions rely solely on shape, color, size, visual location, orientation, or sound.

tests.title: Use of Color
tests.applicability: Content using color to convey information, actions, responses, or distinctions.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Browser, grayscale/color simulation, and reviewer checklist
tests.limitations: Automation cannot reliably infer all meaning conveyed by color or the adequacy of additional visual cues.

tests.title: Images of Text
tests.applicability: Images that may contain text, subject to customizable and essential exceptions.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local OCR plus browser and reviewer checklist
tests.limitations: OCR can only assist discovery; a human must determine whether text could be presented with real text and whether exceptions apply.

tests.title: Non-text Contrast
tests.applicability: User interface components and graphical objects needed to identify controls, states, or content.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local pixel color sampler plus structured visual review
tests.limitations: Human judgment is needed to identify required visual information, boundaries, states, graphical objects, and exceptions.

tests.title: Keyboard
tests.applicability: All content functionality, subject to the path-dependent-input exception.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Browser keyboard-only session with local interaction recorder
tests.limitations: A human must discover and attempt all functionality and determine whether any exception applies.

tests.title: Character Key Shortcuts
tests.applicability: Content implementing shortcuts using only letter, punctuation, number, or symbol characters.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Browser plus keyboard/speech-input review checklist
tests.limitations: Shortcuts may be undocumented or state-dependent; human investigation is required.

tests.title: Timing Adjustable
tests.applicability: Processes with time limits set by content.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Browser with local clock/interaction recorder and reviewer checklist
tests.limitations: A human must identify all time limits and determine whether real-time, essential, or longer-than-20-hours exceptions apply.

tests.title: Pause, Stop, Hide
tests.applicability: Moving, blinking, scrolling, or auto-updating information meeting the criterion's timing and presentation conditions.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Browser with local screen recording and reviewer checklist
tests.limitations: Human judgment is needed to identify distraction, parallel presentation, essentiality, and whether controls satisfy the criterion.

tests.title: Focus Order
tests.applicability: Pages navigated sequentially where sequence affects meaning or operation.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Browser keyboard session with local focus-order overlay
tests.limitations: A human must determine whether the sequence preserves meaning and operability.

tests.title: Multiple Ways
tests.applicability: Pages within a set of web pages, excluding pages that are a step in or result of a process.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local crawler plus reviewer checklist
tests.limitations: A human must define the page set, identify process exceptions, and judge whether at least two valid ways locate each page.

tests.title: Pointer Gestures
tests.applicability: Functionality using multipoint or path-based pointer gestures.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local browser/device emulation plus pointer-interaction recorder
tests.limitations: A human must discover gesture-dependent functionality and determine whether a gesture is essential.

tests.title: Pointer Cancellation
tests.applicability: Functionality operated with a single pointer.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local browser pointer-event recorder and reviewer checklist
tests.limitations: A human must judge completion timing, reversal, and whether down-event completion is essential.

tests.title: Motion Actuation
tests.applicability: Functionality triggered by device or user motion.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local device/sensor emulator plus reviewer checklist
tests.limitations: Requires human/device testing to discover behavior and assess supported-interface or essential exceptions.

tests.title: Dragging Movements
tests.applicability: Functionality that uses dragging movement for operation.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local browser pointer recorder and reviewer checklist
tests.limitations: A human must discover all drag functionality and determine whether alternatives work or dragging is essential.

tests.title: Language of Parts
tests.applicability: Pages containing passages or phrases in languages different from the page's default language.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local language detector plus browser and reviewer checklist
tests.limitations: Language detection is probabilistic; a human must identify passages and evaluate names, technical terms, indeterminate words, and vernacular exceptions.

tests.title: Consistent Identification
tests.applicability: Components with the same functionality across a set of web pages.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local crawler/component inventory plus reviewer checklist
tests.limitations: A human must determine whether components have the same functionality and whether their identification is consistent.

tests.title: Error Identification
tests.applicability: User input where errors can be automatically detected.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright form scripts plus structured reviewer checklist
tests.limitations: A human must determine whether each error is identified and described to the user in text.

tests.title: Error Suggestion
tests.applicability: Detected input errors for which correction suggestions are known, subject to security or purpose constraints.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Playwright form scripts plus content-review checklist
tests.limitations: Human judgment is required to assess whether suggestions are known, useful, and safe to provide.

tests.title: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
tests.applicability: Pages causing legal commitments or financial transactions, modifying/deleting user-controlled data, or submitting test responses.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local scripted journeys plus transactional-review checklist
tests.limitations: A human must identify covered transactions and judge whether at least one required safeguard is effective.

tests.title: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
tests.applicability: Authentication processes, subject to object-recognition and personal-content exceptions.
tests.suggestedLocalTool: Local browser authentication scripts plus cognitive-accessibility checklist
tests.limitations: A human must determine whether a cognitive function test is required and whether an assistance mechanism or exception satisfies the criterion.
